jobs.description: About Allianz Global InvestorsAllianz Global Investors is a leading active asset manager, managing assets for individuals, families, and institutions worldwide. Our shared goal to shape a future of opportunity for our clients is foundational to our culture and our values. We look to attract, and actively nurture, individuals with the drive to achieve excellence at every stage of the investment experience.We believe an inclusive culture is key to a flourishing workforce. Not only do we celebrate the broad range of experiences, backgrounds, and attributes that our workforce brings, but we support our people to live and work in a way that promotes their own wellbeing.Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges is what makes us a unique employer.  We are united by a shared commitment: to put our clients first and at the centre of everything we do. Their needs inspire our thinking and guide our actions.  Together, we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and confident to explore, grow and shape a better future - for our clients and for the world around us. At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. The foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and where integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust are at the heart of our culture.  We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations. If you feel inspired to promote the active asset management experience, this is the place for you. Join our international, technology-enabled, and agile environment. Simply upload your CV in English to apply for this position.  If you need support to navigate our websites or at any stage during your application, please send an email with your request to recruiting@allianzgi.com. To Recruitment Agencies:Allianz Global Investors has an in-house recruitment team that sources great candidates directly. Therefore, Allianz Global Investors does not accept unsolicited resumes from agency or search firm recruiters.When we do work with recruitment agencies, that engagement is formalized by a contract. At Allianz, technology never replaces human judgment. Every application is carefully reviewed by our recruiting teams, ensuring a fair, thoughtful, and personal hiring process.109407 | Asset & Investment Management | Professional | n.a. | Allianz Global Investors | Full-Time | PermanentThe Private Markets Solutions Team designs and manages diversified private markets portfolios across bespoke mandates and evergreen funds, translating client objectives and market views into allocation, portfolio construction and investment decisions. Working across private equity, private debt, infrastructure, and selectively real estate, the team partners with specialist investment teams to access their deal flow in primaries, co-investments and secondaries while also investing in the platform's direct strategies and performing selective, complementary sourcing. The team retains end-to-end responsibility for portfolio strategy, pacing, investment decisions and ongoing portfolio steering. The team is part of risklab, the solutions pillar of Allianz Global Investors' global investment platform, and works closely with other risklab teams, on modelling of private markets, strategic asset allocation advice, and holistic public-private portfolios.The Associate Portfolio Manager takes ownership of defined portfolio-management responsibilities across diversified private markets mandates and evergreen funds, translating client objectives, portfolio analysis and market views into actionable allocation and investment recommendations. In addition, the role helps develop the team's investment strategy capability by producing cross-asset-class research, relative-value assessments and investment theses that inform portfolio decisions.What you will do- Manage defined portfolio workstreams - and progressively portfolios - across private equity, private debt, infrastructure and real estate, under the oversight of senior portfolio managers.- Develop allocation, pacing and portfolio-construction recommendations based on client objectives, portfolio exposures, cash-flow forecasts and investment guidelines.- Evaluate investment opportunities in a total-portfolio context and formulate clear recommendations for portfolio reviews and investment committees.- Develop market views, relative-value assessments and investment theses across private markets, working closely with specialist investment teams.- Translate investment research and market developments into practical implications for portfolio allocation, construction and steering with the clear aim to generate extra returns.- Take ownership of high-quality portfolio analyses and decision materials, coordinating inputs across investment teams and functions and delivering reliably under tight deadlines.- Improve investment frameworks, analytical tools and team processes, while guiding analysts on assigned workstreams.What you bring- Master's degree or equivalent qualification in finance, economics, business administration or another quantitative discipline; a PhD, CFA and/or CAIA qualification is an advantage.- 3-5 years of relevant experience in private markets, investment management/ consulting or investment/ academic research; demonstrable private markets expertise is required.- Strong understanding of private-markets investment and portfolio-management concepts, ideally across more than one asset class.- Excellent quantitative and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret portfolio data, market research and cash-flow analysis and turn them into actionable investment recommendations.- Proven ability to conduct independent research, develop investment views and communicate clear, well-supported conclusions to senior stakeholders and investment committees.- Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills; experience with data-analysis or visualisation tools is an advantage.- Structured, reliable and quality-focused, with the ability to take ownership of complex workstreams and deliver high-quality results under tight deadlines.- Flexible, proactive and self-reliant, with the judgement to manage changing priorities, identify issues and drive work forward with limited supervision.- Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the confidence to challenge constructively and work effectively across asset classes, investment teams and functions.- Fluent verbal and written skills in both English and German required.- Experience with Data Analytics, Data Modelling and Microsoft CoPilot.

jobs.description: About usAirbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.Job descriptionIn order to support the Laboratory for Enabling Technologies (LET), Airbus Defence and Space is offering aMaster Thesis within Electric Propulsion (d/f/m)Are you looking for a master thesis and want to get to know the work of an Electric Propulsion Engineer (d/f/m)?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Laboratory for Enabling Technologies (LET) team as a masters student (d/f/m)!- Location: Friedrichshafen- Start: February 2027- Duration: 6 MonthsAirbus in Friedrichshafen/Immenstaad, Germany, operates the Laboratory for Enabling Technologies (LET). The task of the LET is to develop, enhance and prove technologies for future space missions and to support all future programmes, in general. During the last years, the LET builds up deep heritage and knowledge, in the field of laser metrology and Electric Propulsion (EP).In order to enhance the in-house EP development of the Advanced Cusp Field Thruster, the LET hosts facilities to characterize electric thrusters and components required for several EP related development projects. In the framework of these activities, we are offering an internship or master thesis student position.Your locationAt the Airbus site in Friedrichshafen you will be working on innovation where others spend their holidays. Enjoy panoramic views of Lake Constance while having lunch in our canteen. And after work, join one of our many corporate sports groups to go running, sailing or skiing.Your benefits- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 35-hour week (flexitime).- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.- Work with modern/diversified technologies.- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.Your tasks and responsibilities- Development of test equipment for Electric Propulsion testing, such as thrust balance or plasma diagnostic systems.- Electric Propulsion thruster development, including testing of thrusters under development.- Cathode development by rapid prototyping.- Development of test facility automation and control systems.and many other activities required in order to excel in Electric Propulsion Research and Development. Desired skills and qualifications- Enrolled full-time student (d/f/m) in the area of Electrical Engineering, Physics, Material Science, Space Engineering or an equivalent field of study with relevant transcripts of records- Hands-on experience in any technical field is desirable.- Basic programming knowledge Matlab, Python and/or LabView.- Good knowledge in your dedicated field of engineering.- Good knowledge and understanding of measurement and control engineering.- Basic knowledge of optical/laser engineering and plasma physics would be an asset.- Fluent English language skills and German would be an advantage.Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.Not a 100% match?
